check('iso z', lambda: normalise("2026-11-27T09:30:00Z"), '2026-11-27T09:30:00+00:00')
check('offset', lambda: normalise("2026-11-27T15:00:00+05:30"), '2026-11-27T09:30:00+00:00')
check('day first', lambda: normalise("27/11/2026 09:30"), '2026-11-27T09:30:00+00:00')
check('epoch', lambda: normalise("1795771800"), '2026-11-27T09:30:00+00:00')
check('naive iso is utc', lambda: normalise(" 2026-11-27 09:30 "), '2026-11-27T09:30:00+00:00')
check('garbage raises', lambda: raises(lambda: normalise("yesterday"), ValueError), True)

check('new york winter', lambda: to_utc("2026-01-15T09:00:00", "America/New_York"), '2026-01-15T14:00:00+00:00')
check('new york summer', lambda: to_utc("2026-07-15T09:00:00", "America/New_York"), '2026-07-15T13:00:00+00:00')
check('kolkata', lambda: to_utc("2026-11-27T09:00:00", "Asia/Kolkata"), '2026-11-27T03:30:00+00:00')
check('utc', lambda: to_utc("2026-11-27T09:00:00", "UTC"), '2026-11-27T09:00:00+00:00')
check('crosses date', lambda: to_utc("2026-11-27T02:00:00", "Asia/Tokyo"), '2026-11-26T17:00:00+00:00')
check('unknown zone raises KeyError', lambda: raises(lambda: to_utc("2026-01-01T00:00:00", "Mars/Olympus"), KeyError), True)

check('normal', lambda: local_hours(date(2026, 11, 27), "America/New_York"), 24.0)
check('spring forward', lambda: local_hours(date(2026, 3, 8), "America/New_York"), 23.0)
check('fall back', lambda: local_hours(date(2026, 11, 1), "America/New_York"), 25.0)
check('london spring', lambda: local_hours(date(2026, 3, 29), "Europe/London"), 23.0)
check('no dst zone', lambda: local_hours(date(2026, 3, 8), "Asia/Kolkata"), 24.0)
check('utc', lambda: local_hours(date(2026, 3, 8), "UTC"), 24.0)

check('wall across dst', lambda: add_hours("2026-03-07T12:00:00", "America/New_York", 24, "wall"), '2026-03-08T12:00:00-04:00')
check('elapsed across dst', lambda: add_hours("2026-03-07T12:00:00", "America/New_York", 24, "elapsed"), '2026-03-08T13:00:00-04:00')
check('same without dst', lambda: add_hours("2026-06-01T12:00:00", "America/New_York", 24, "elapsed"), '2026-06-02T12:00:00-04:00')
check('fall back elapsed', lambda: add_hours("2026-10-31T12:00:00", "America/New_York", 24, "elapsed"), '2026-11-01T11:00:00-05:00')
check('negative', lambda: add_hours("2026-03-09T12:00:00", "America/New_York", -24, "elapsed"), '2026-03-08T12:00:00-04:00')
check('bad mode raises', lambda: raises(lambda: add_hours("2026-01-01T00:00:00", "UTC", 1, "x"), ValueError), True)

check('november', lambda: month_bounds(date(2026, 11, 27)), ('2026-11-01', '2026-11-30'))
check('leap feb', lambda: month_bounds(date(2028, 2, 10)), ('2028-02-01', '2028-02-29'))
check('non-leap feb', lambda: month_bounds(date(2026, 2, 28)), ('2026-02-01', '2026-02-28'))
check('december', lambda: month_bounds(date(2026, 12, 1)), ('2026-12-01', '2026-12-31'))
check('datetime keeps time', lambda: month_bounds(datetime(2026, 4, 5, 9, 30)), ('2026-04-01T09:30:00', '2026-04-30T09:30:00'))
check('century non-leap', lambda: month_bounds(date(2100, 2, 1)), ('2100-02-01', '2100-02-28'))

check('clamp feb', lambda: add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 1), '2026-02-28')
check('leap', lambda: add_months(date(2028, 1, 31), 1), '2028-02-29')
check('year rollover', lambda: add_months(date(2026, 11, 30), 3), '2027-02-28')
check('negative', lambda: add_months(date(2026, 3, 15), -14), '2025-01-15')
check('zero', lambda: add_months(date(2026, 5, 5), 0), '2026-05-05')
check('twelve', lambda: add_months(date(2028, 2, 29), 12), '2029-02-28')

check('one week', lambda: business_days(date(2026, 11, 23), date(2026, 11, 30)), 5)
check('with holiday', lambda: business_days(date(2026, 11, 23), date(2026, 11, 30), [date(2026, 11, 26)]), 4)
check('weekend only', lambda: business_days(date(2026, 11, 28), date(2026, 11, 30)), 0)
check('empty range', lambda: business_days(date(2026, 1, 1), date(2026, 1, 1)), 0)
check('reversed', lambda: business_days(date(2026, 1, 9), date(2026, 1, 1)), 0)
check('holiday on weekend', lambda: business_days(date(2026, 11, 27), date(2026, 12, 1), [date(2026, 11, 28)]), 2)

check('from', lambda: from_epoch_ms(1795771800123), '2026-11-27T09:30:00.123+00:00')
check('to', lambda: to_epoch_ms("2026-11-27T09:30:00.123+00:00"), 1795771800123)
check('round trip', lambda: to_epoch_ms(from_epoch_ms(1700000000999)), 1700000000999)
check('naive is utc', lambda: to_epoch_ms("1970-01-01T00:00:01"), 1000)
check('offset', lambda: to_epoch_ms("1970-01-01T05:30:00+05:30"), 0)
check('before epoch', lambda: from_epoch_ms(-1), '1969-12-31T23:59:59.999+00:00')

check('seconds', lambda: humanize(7), '7s')
check('minutes', lambda: humanize(185), '3m 05s')
check('hours', lambda: humanize(3723), '1h 02m 03s')
check('days', lambda: humanize(93784), '1d 02h 03m 04s')
check('zero', lambda: humanize(0), '0s')
check('fraction', lambda: humanize(59.9), '59s')

check('november', lambda: iso_week(date(2026, 11, 27)), '2026-W48')
check('early january', lambda: iso_week(date(2027, 1, 1)), '2026-W53')
check('late december', lambda: iso_week(date(2026, 12, 31)), '2026-W53')
check('week 1', lambda: iso_week(date(2026, 1, 1)), '2026-W01')
check('53-week year', lambda: iso_week(date(2026, 12, 28)), '2026-W53')
check('datetime', lambda: iso_week(datetime(2026, 6, 1, 12)), '2026-W23')

check('before cutoff', lambda: ship_date("2026-11-25T20:00:00Z", "America/New_York"), '2026-11-25')
check('after cutoff', lambda: ship_date("2026-11-25T23:00:00Z", "America/New_York"), '2026-11-26')
check('friday late', lambda: ship_date("2026-11-27T22:30:00Z", "America/New_York"), '2026-11-30')
check('saturday', lambda: ship_date("2026-11-28T12:00:00Z", "Europe/London"), '2026-11-30')
check('utc date differs from local', lambda: ship_date("2026-11-26T02:00:00Z", "America/Los_Angeles"), '2026-11-26')
check('custom cutoff', lambda: ship_date("2026-11-24T10:30:00Z", "Asia/Kolkata", cutoff_hour=15), '2026-11-25')
